item.title: SpaceXAI — Creators of Grok, the AI Chatbot
item.description: SpaceXAI builds Grok, an AI chatbot with voice chat, image and video generation, real-time search, and advanced reasoning. Try Grok at grok.com.

item.title: News: Research, Product & Company Updates | SpaceXAI
item.description: It includes native tool use and real-time search integration, and is available now to SuperGrok and Premium+ subscribers, as well as through the xAI API. We are also introducing a new SuperGrok Heavy tier with access to Grok 4 Heavy - the most powerful version of Grok 4.

item.title: SpaceXAI - Wikipedia
item.description: On February 2, 2026, SpaceX acquired xAI in an all-stock transaction that structured xAI as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX. [8][35] The acquisition valued SpaceX at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion, for a combined total of $1.25 trillion.

item.title: What Is xAI? The Company Behind Grok | Built In
item.description: xAI is an AI company founded by Elon Musk to counter a perceived liberal bias in generative AI tools. xAI integrates its Grok chatbot into its social media platform X, and its Grok 3 and Grok 4 models are powered by the company’s Colossus supercomputer.

item.title: SpaceXAI Console — Grok API & Developer Tools
item.description: Build with the Grok API. Access SpaceXAI's AI chatbot models, voice API, image generation, and real-time search from the SpaceXAI Console.

item.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence(XAI) - GeeksforGeeks
item.description: XAI can assist them in comprehending the behavior of an AI model and identifying possible problems like AI. Overall, the value of explainable AI lies in its ability to provide transparent and interpretable machine-learning models that can be understood and trusted by humans.

item.title: xAI | AI Wiki
item.description: xAI is an artificial intelligence business established in 2023 under Elon Musk, who led it before the SpaceX acquisition. [2] It develops the Grok family of large language models, consumer and enterprise AI products, application programming interfaces, and large-scale computing infrastructure.

item.title: XAI | Elon Musk, Artificial Intelligence, X, Grok, Integrations ...
item.description: What is xAI and who founded it? xAI is a start-up company founded by Elon Musk in March 2023 that became the parent company of X (formerly Twitter) in March 2025. xAI was created to counter what Musk described as the political correctness in other artificial intelligence (AI) models.

item.title: Xai: Arbitrum Layer 3 Blockchain | XAI Games
item.description: Xai provides a user experience tailored for traditional gamers, abstracting web3 interaction on the backend. Game developers benefit from larger contract limits, while enjoying fast and cost-effective transactions similar to other Arbitrum chains.

item.title: xAI - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
item.description: xAI has also used its Grok models to launch Grokipedia, a competitor for Wikipedia, however it is not a separate model. Grokipedia is an "AI powered wikipedia" that is powered by AI. It aims to be unbiased and not political, or controlled by any single political wing.
